distribution.narrative: Johnson et al. (2020) confirms Liaoning occurrence and corrects historical C. viburni misidentifications. Yang (2020) additionally lists Heilongjiang; the reviewed mainland distribution therefore includes Liaoning and Heilongjiang.

host_note: Juglans mandshurica and Fraxinus mandshurica retained as current reviewed hosts.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Cryphalus scopiger Berger, 1917.

taxonomic_history.name: Cryphalus scopiger
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: Historical Juglans-associated Chinese C. viburni records likely represent C. scopiger.
